title: The Long Tail
summary: Sector review: describe mission length properly, find the record, and write the APA sentence.
hints: One `summarise()` makes all four: `astronauts |> summarise(mean_hours = mean(hours_mission), median_hours = median(hours_mission), sd_hours = sd(hours_mission), iqr_hours = IQR(hours_mission))`.
`slice_max(hours_mission, n = 1)` keeps the row with the largest value; then `select(name, year_of_mission, hours_mission)`.
`sprintf("Mdn = %.0f h", centre$median_hours)` puts a rounded number into text. Build the whole sentence in one `sprintf()` with four `%.0f`s.
